name: Hezekiah
summary: A son of Ahaz who became king of Judah and trusted the LORD like no other king of Judah. When Assyria threatened Jerusalem, he prayed, and the LORD saved the city.

key_moments.title: Breaking the Bronze Serpent
key_moments.description: Hezekiah did right like David his father. He took away the high places and smashed the bronze serpent Moses had made, because Israel had been burning incense to it.

key_moments.title: Spreads Assyria's Letter Before the LORD
key_moments.description: Hezekiah took the king of Assyria's threatening letter into the LORD's house and spread it out before Him in prayer. That night the angel of the LORD struck the Assyrian camp, and Sennacherib went home to Nineveh.

key_moments.title: Given Fifteen More Years
key_moments.description: When Hezekiah was dying, he prayed and wept, and the LORD promised to heal him and add fifteen years to his life. As a sign, the shadow went back ten steps on the dial of Ahaz.

key_moments.title: Shows His Treasures to Babylon
key_moments.description: Hezekiah showed the messengers from Babylon everything in his storehouses. Isaiah then told him that all of it would one day be carried off to Babylon.

key_moments.title: Holds a Great Passover
key_moments.description: Hezekiah sent letters across Israel and Judah, calling people to Jerusalem to celebrate the passover. He prayed for those who were not clean, and the LORD heard him, and Jerusalem had its greatest joy since Solomon.
